findings.description: If emergency close still leaves residual exposure after hedge failure or partial hedge fill, the contract only requires logging and does not mandate a fail-closed trading-permission change or open-intent block.

evidence.quote: log the failure and proceed to step 4 with exposure unchanged;

findings.proposed_fix: Require a fail-closed state transition when `exposure_usd_after > 0`, such as forcing `ReduceOnly`/`Kill` or latching open intents blocked until reconciliation.

findings.description: Freshness gating depends on Appendix A values, but this fixture does not provide a resolvable Appendix A anchor or inline source-of-truth values.
findings.proposed_fix: Add the referenced Appendix A content or inline the authoritative freshness parameters in this section.

findings.description: The contract fixes an exact retry schedule and hard attempt cap, but no acceptance test asserts the specific 3-attempt limit with 5/10/20 tick buffers.

evidence.quote: buffer doubles each retry: attempt 2 = 10 ticks, attempt 3 = 20 ticks

findings.proposed_fix: Add an AT that proves emergency close stops after 3 IOC attempts and uses the exact 5/10/20 tick buffer sequence.

findings.description: AT-235 uses an approximate success condition for residual exposure, which makes pass/fail subjective across implementations.
findings.proposed_fix: Define a numeric residual-exposure tolerance and measurement basis for AT-235 pass/fail evaluation.
